rules.name: supervisor
rules.why: Long-context model for the orchestrator; Kimi K3 as fallback.

rules.name: plan
rules.when: Planning: turning a spec into tasks, or any request with ambiguity about what to build.
rules.why: Captain rule (2026-10-02): Sol and Opus are reserved for planning and code review.

rules.name: review
rules.when: Code review of a task branch; the deliverable is findings.
rules.why: Captain rule (2026-10-02): Sol and Opus are reserved for planning and code review.

rules.name: design
rules.when: UX or UI design, mockups, visual direction, game feel.
rules.why: Captain rule (2026-10-02): Astra and Fable are reserved for design work.

rules.name: build-hard
rules.when: Hard but clear work where mistakes are costly: business logic, schemas, money, concurrency, security.
rules.why: Spend priority (captain, 2026-10-02): OpenCode Go first, then Kimi, then OpenAI and Gemini, then Claude.

rules.name: build-large
rules.when: Complicated but clear development: the approach is known but the change is large.

rules.name: build-bounded
rules.when: Bounded work: a small feature or a bug fix in a few files.

rules.name: build-parallel
rules.when: Executing one slice of a plan designed for parallelism.
rules.why: Captain rule (2026-10-04): K3 runs through pi.

rules.name: trivial
rules.when: A mechanical edit with no judgment: rename, typo, formatting, dependency bump.

rules.name: lookup
rules.when: A read-only question: where or how something is used, summarise a log.

rules.name: retry
rules.when: A previous worker failed, got stuck, or produced an unusable result on this task.
rules.why: A different model family than the one that failed.

rules.name: fix
rules.when: Fix round after review findings, run in a pane with review_loop.
rules.why: review_loop needs an interactive pi session.
